resources.string: Follows the system unless you choose one here. What Bothy says is not affected.
Oatmeal and pine in the light. A warm dark in the dark. The head unit keeps its own night colors.

Auto follows the screen: a phone or a tablet held upright gets the phone screens, a tablet on its side or a head unit the console. On a phone, or with Phone chosen, Bothy does not stay over other apps; it comes up when woken or when a task comes in.
Auto follows the screen and how it is held. Phone and tablet also behave differently outside the app.
